Deeluxe Hair and Beauty has been created from our love for what we do.. We are strong, independent family focused women who love to pamper and make people feel better about themselves with our passion and skills in beauty and hairdressing. Best in Class

بناءً على 1,314 مراجعة رائعة من العملاء

Attentive care is the defining thread at Deeluxe Hair & Beauty, where clients appreciate stylists who listen closely and help them feel comfortable throughout their appointments. The indulgence head spa and wash, cut and blow-dry are particular favourites, with thoughtful service and relaxing treatments leaving guests feeling refreshed and happy with their results.
